ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there are two slanted blue straight lines, with the same pink arrow markings beside them, indicating that these two straight lines are parallel. There is also a blue slanted line passing through these two parallel lines, serving as a transversal. Near the upper intersection, the angle (2x)° is labeled, and near the lower intersection, 54° is labeled. Reasoning: The 54° marked at the lower intersection and the interior angle on the upper left side of the same intersection are vertical angles, so this interior angle is also equal to 54°. Since the two straight lines with the same arrow markings are parallel, the (2x)° angle at the upper intersection and this 54° interior angle below are same-side interior angles, so they are supplementary. Thus 2x + 54 = 180, obtaining 2x = 126, so x = 63.
